goal: Implement and release FOUR priorities strictly in this order in indexer-go; complete each feature's CI5-gated squash merge and clean main sync BEFORE implementing the next. Deliver working tested code, not plans/interfaces/stubs. 1) Source-backed supported-chain blob supply/verification contracts and usable opt-in bounded transport integrated with existing proof/core, immutable admission, head/window/capacity/restart/reorg/exact ACK; offline mock success and missing/pruned/wrong-fork/proof/cancel/reorg failures. Keep unsupported pinned Arc admission closed; KZG is not beacon/PeerDAS verification. 2) Bounded address/block-range call queries, coverage, reorg orphan trace preservation/query and explicit GraphQL/JSON-RPC contracts; preserve epoch/original ref/digest, pagination/reserved DB-only reads and uncollected semantics. 3) E6 real cryptographic consensus/validator/trust-anchor/fork and ancestry/finality/reorg verification for an evidence-backed supported profile, with native/spec-derived good/bad fixtures, validator transitions/fork and recovery; unsupported profiles fail closed; RPC hash/interface/synthetic-success alone is insufficient. 4) Justified native index/MDBX reclamation plus consistent matched backup/restore and retained-state-floor verification under existing E3 ownership/lease/permit/checkpoint/exact-ACK/intent/completion/release gates, proven on owned temporary native DBs with interruption/corruption/missing/foreign-data and recovery tests. Audit existing implementations and choose justified technical defaults without routine user questions. Preserve every constraint supplied below at the TOP LEVEL of the executable Seed, provide meaningful runnable verification for each of the four features, and do not exempt their verification. Release means PR/CI/squash/main only. At completion report four releases, PRs, main SHA, tests, own cache cleanup and remaining held operations in Korean.

acceptance_criteria.description: Supported-chain blob supply and verification operate through usable opt-in bounded transport integrated with existing proof/core. Source-backed contracts, immutable admission, head/window/capacity limits, restart, reorg, and exact ACK are enforced. Offline mocks demonstrate success and missing, pruned, wrong-fork, invalid-proof, cancellation, and reorg failures. Unsupported pinned Arc admission remains closed, and KZG alone cannot satisfy beacon/PeerDAS verification.
acceptance_criteria.verify_command: t=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R . "$t/indexer-go" && cd "$t/indexer-go" && go test -json ./... -run '^TestSeedPriority1BlobSupplyVerification$' -count=1 > "$t/results.json" && python3 -c "import json,sys; events=[json.loads(s) for s in open(sys.argv[1])]; assert any(e.get('Action')=='pass' and e.get('Test')=='TestSeedPriority1BlobSupplyVerification' for e in events); assert not any(e.get('Action')=='fail' for e in events)" "$t/results.json"

acceptance_criteria.description: Address/block-range call queries enforce bounds and pagination and expose coverage and uncollected-data semantics through explicit GraphQL and JSON-RPC contracts. Reorg-orphaned traces remain preserved and queryable with their epoch, original reference, and digest intact, and reserved DB-only read behavior is preserved.

ontology_schema.name: IndexerPriorityReleaseContract
ontology_schema.description: The four ordered feature outcomes, their source-backed verification evidence, preserved indexing and storage invariants, and gated release completion.

fields.name: feature_outcome
fields.description: Observable working behavior delivered by the priority.

fields.name: supported_profile
fields.description: Supported chain or consensus profile and the source evidence justifying its verification contract.

fields.name: blob_contract
fields.description: Supply, verification, bounded transport, immutable admission, head/window/capacity, restart, reorg, and exact-ACK behavior.

fields.name: query_contract
fields.description: Address/block bounds, pagination, GraphQL/JSON-RPC behavior, coverage, uncollected semantics, and reserved DB-only reads.

fields.name: trace_provenance
fields.description: Preserved epoch, original reference, digest, and reorg-orphan status of queryable traces.

fields.name: consensus_contract
fields.description: Cryptographic consensus, validator transitions, trust anchors, forks, ancestry, finality, reorg, recovery, and unsupported-profile rejection.

fields.name: storage_contract
fields.description: Native reclamation, matched backup/restore, retained-state floor, and preserved E3 gates.

fields.name: verification_evidence
fields.description: Runnable checks, fixture provenance, success/failure/recovery results, and native temporary-database evidence.

fields.name: release_evidence
fields.description: PR, CI5 gate result, squash merge, main SHA, clean synchronization, and evidence of ordering relative to subsequent implementation.

fields.name: completion_report
fields.description: Korean report covering four releases, PRs, final main SHA, tests, execution-owned cache cleanup, and remaining held operations.

evaluation_principles.name: Functional completeness
evaluation_principles.description: Judge working integrated behavior for every stated feature and preserved invariant; plans, interfaces, and stubs do not satisfy delivery.

evaluation_principles.name: Evidence-backed verification
evaluation_principles.description: Require source-backed supported profiles, real cryptographic checks, meaningful runnable feature verification, and the specified failure and recovery evidence.

evaluation_principles.name: Ordered release integrity
evaluation_principles.description: Require each feature's CI5-gated squash merge and clean main synchronization before implementation of the next feature.

evaluation_principles.name: Preservation and completion evidence
evaluation_principles.description: Check query provenance, unsupported-profile closure, E3 gates, storage consistency, and the complete Korean release report.

exit_conditions.name: Completed
exit_conditions.description: All requested feature and release outcomes are satisfied.
exit_conditions.criteria: All five acceptance criteria pass; four ordered CI5-gated squash releases are complete; main is clean and synchronized; the Korean report includes releases, PRs, final main SHA, tests, execution-owned cache cleanup, and remaining held operations.

exit_conditions.name: Next-priority gate
exit_conditions.description: Later-priority implementation cannot begin while its predecessor's release is incomplete.
exit_conditions.criteria: If the current priority lacks its completed CI5-gated squash merge or clean main synchronization, do not begin implementing the next priority and do not declare the overall task complete.

exit_conditions.name: Unsupported-profile closure
exit_conditions.criteria: An unsupported pinned Arc or consensus profile cannot be admitted or represented as successfully verified; unsupported-profile rejection does not establish a supported-profile success path.
